sources.details: For12 documents, a=floor(.8*12)=9,b=floor(.9*12)=10 so train9,validation1,test2. With V17,W16: MLP VW+CW²+W+WV+V=577+256C (833,1345,1857); bigram V²=289. Byte A=65+8=73,EOS2;[73,2] has2 IDs,2<32. after−before<0 iff after<before. These are transparent arithmetic, not empirical quality claims; full notes in a_primary.
